projects.title: ContractKit
projects.description: An AI-powered contract intelligence platform that automates contract review, clause extraction, policy validation, and compliance analysis using large language models and retrieval-augmented generation.

projects.title: Beyond Vision: RGB to Infrared Image Translation
projects.description: A deep learning framework for generating infrared imagery from RGB images using encoder-decoder architectures. The project explores cross-spectrum image translation for surveillance, autonomous systems, and low-light perception.
highlights: Trained on KAIST and FLAME datasets
Evaluated using PSNR, SSIM and MSE

projects.title: Pyantra
projects.description: Typed, observable, reliable workflows for production AI agents. Build agent pipelines as typed graphs of nodes and edges with reliability, checkpoints, and observability built in by default.
highlights: Typed node/edge graphs with compile-time validation
Retries, backoff, timeouts and circuit breakers
Parallel fan-out with sync and async execution
Zero dependencies — pure Python standard library
